title: 26 CFR 1.461-4, Economic performance (4-1-25 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Code of Federal Regulations

passages.question: What decides the tax timing of the warranty reserve, which rose from $11,600.00 to $14,900.00 while $4,200.00 of claims were paid?
passages.excerpt: if the liability of a taxpayer requires the taxpayer to provide services or property to another person, economic performance occurs as the taxpayer incurs costs (within the meaning of § 1.446-1(c)(1)(ii)) in connection with the satisfaction of the liability.

passages.question: What decides the tax timing of the cost-to-complete reserve, where the $700.00 opening balance was fully worked off and $1,100.00 was newly provided?
passages.excerpt: if the liability of a taxpayer arises out of the providing of services or property to the taxpayer by another person, economic performance occurs as the services or property is provided.

passages.question: Do the $4,900.00 of payments against last year's provisions create a deduction this year, and does the net $3,700.00 add-back reflect that correctly?
passages.excerpt: arises under any workers compensation act or out of any tort, breach of contract, or violation of law, economic performance occurs as payment is made to the person to which the liability is owed.
